name: Be stuck in a jail cell simulator and thats it...?
desc:
The title of the game says it all...

The game may sound boring. But you have 2 games and 4 comic books and 1 encyclopedia (A Roblox encyclopedia) to make you not that bored being stuck in a prison cell. You can't go out of your cell unless you have the prison key.

Update: 
+Added the "Sewers"
+Added a new Badge

Have a fun time in prison.
